verdicts.reason: Both use the same sensible vertical restack, but both break the symptom list. Items run together on shared lines ("Shortness of breath Dry cough", "Sore throat Headache"), so the 6-item list no longer reads as six items. In both, the doctor illustration crowds the yellow CTA at the bottom. A has slightly better margins and more space between the headline, the list and the illustration. In B, "SYMPTOMS" nearly touches both side edges and the list sits jammed under the headline, so B looks more cramped.
